storefront_carts_owner_check.name: storefront_carts_owner_check
storefront_carts_owner_check.value: (user_id is not null) <> (guest_token is not null)

journal_entries_source_unique.name: journal_entries_source_unique
journal_entries_source_unique.where: "journal_entries"."source_type" is not null and "journal_entries"."source_id" is not null

journal_entries_source_complete.name: journal_entries_source_complete
journal_entries_source_complete.value: ("journal_entries"."source_type" is null and "journal_entries"."source_id" is null) or (btrim("journal_entries"."source_type") <> '' and btrim("journal_entries"."source_id") <> '')

journal_entries_posting_audit_valid.name: journal_entries_posting_audit_valid
journal_entries_posting_audit_valid.value:
("journal_entries"."status" = 'draft' and "journal_entries"."posted_at" is null and "journal_entries"."posted_by" is null)
      or ("journal_entries"."status" in ('posted', 'reversed') and "journal_entries"."posted_at" is not null and "journal_entries"."posted_by" is not null)
